item.title: National summit on extortion crisis to be held in B.C., premier says
item.description: Premier David Eby said on Wednesday that the federal government is committing 20 more officers and helicopter support to police in B.C.

item.title: Alberta family details ‘heartbreaking’ predatory towing experience, hopes for change
item.description: A crash involving her son already made for a traumatic day for Sheri Stephenson, but she says the predatory behaviour of a local towing company made a bad situation even worse.

item.title: Kelowna forum targets crime as local businesses push for change
item.description: The more than two-hour meeting, which brought together business owners, city officials, police, and provincial representatives, quickly revealed deep frustration in the room.

item.title: The lesser-known ways the Stollery Children’s Hospital goes above and beyond for patients
item.description: While the Stollery Children's Hospital is well-known for world-class medical care — it's the softer touches that make a big difference in lives of patients and families too.

item.title: Fraud charges dropped against all 11 Edmonton tow truck operators accused last year
item.description: Fraud charges against 11 owners of 10 towing companies in Edmonton were dropped about half a year after they were accused of overcharging or defrauding insurance companies.

item.title: Arrest warrant issued for man suspected in crash which killed Manitoba musician, two others
item.description: An arrest warrant has been issued, six months after a Manitoba musician, his partner, and another man was killed in a crash in western Manitoba.

item.title: Trouble in Port Coquitlam neighbourhood after care provider, resident moves in
item.description: The City of Port Coquitlam told Global News that the house isn't authorized to be used for this service and neighbours have been concerned about what's happening.

item.title: Alberta could overtake B.C. in population in the next 10 years: Statistics Canada
item.description: B.C. Premier David Eby said that the province has grown by about 300,000 people in a few years, but he believes that immigration numbers have been reduced by Ottawa.

item.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers sign all-star receiver Tim White
item.description: The Bombers signed receiver Tim White after he was released by the Hamilton Tiger-Cats earlier in the week.

item.title: Bridges powers Knicks past Raptors 119-92
item.description: Mikal Bridges scored 30 points, including 19 in the third quarter, as the New York Knicks rolled past the Toronto Raptors 119-92 on Wednesday.
